chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام saying: The time of maghrib is when the sun sets and its disk disappears.

key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the maghrib prayer time at sunset
key_terms.غَرَبَتِ: it set; referring to the setting of the sun
key_terms.قُرْصُهَا: its disk, meaning the visible orb of the sun
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the designated time or prescribed beginning of an act

ai.seo_question: When does the time of maghrib prayer begin according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the beginning time of maghrib prayer. It indicates that maghrib enters when the sun has set and its disk has disappeared, making it a foundational narration in prayer-time rulings.
